name: Honoka
source:
Kotarou's homeroom teacher, as well as the advisor for the swimming club. She is beautiful and caring, and so is popular with the students. She is referred to as Honoka-sensei by everyone in the class.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2020/03/03/tm/]Official Website[/url]]
